centralThesis: AI makes production cheap, so the scarce skill moves from making the first artifact to deciding what should exist, what deserves to survive, and what can be trusted.
narrativeArc: Start with the cost collapse, name the bottleneck it created, walk the four disciplines one at a time with the demo that proves each, then stack them and show why the frame is a loop rather than a pipeline. Close by relocating human creativity rather than defending it.

chapters.title: Production got cheap
chapters.purpose: Open on the cost collapse rather than the framework, so the reader feels the problem before it is named.
chapters.thesis: When the cost of making falls far enough, the constraint moves from production to discernment.

chapters.title: Four words for what is left
chapters.purpose: Name the four disciplines that the bottleneck now sits behind, and show them as one loop rather than a list.
chapters.thesis: What remains scarce is imagining what could exist, selecting what belongs, refining it far enough, and judging whether it can be trusted.

chapters.title: What could this become
chapters.purpose: Show imagination as a method — moving one vague thought through enough forms to discover the real question.
chapters.thesis: Imagination is not a mood; it is the discipline of moving an idea through representations until the question it answers becomes visible.
sourceSections: Slide 5 – Demo 1: One Vague Thought, Five Representations

chapters.title: What belongs
chapters.purpose: Turn taste from an unexplainable preference into the work of studying first and rejecting well.
chapters.thesis: AI produces optionality; taste is the discipline that converts optionality into direction.

chapters.title: How far is far enough
chapters.purpose: Separate commitment to the problem from attachment to the current artifact, which cheap production makes harder, not easier.
chapters.thesis: Perseverance is commitment to the problem and willingness to destroy a solution that looks good.

chapters.title: Are we justified in trusting it
chapters.purpose: Give the reader an epistemic vocabulary, then show how a fluent paragraph flattens four levels of certainty into one voice.
chapters.thesis: Judgment is naming which claims are validated, which are inferred, and which are merely declared — and scaling verification with the cost of being wrong.

chapters.title: The four at once
chapters.purpose: Stack the disciplines so the reader sees them compounding, then show that the order is not a pipeline.
chapters.thesis: The four disciplines build on one another and loop back: judgment can send you back to imagination.
sourceSections: Slide 12 – Layer Cake: All Four Principles Together
Slide 13 – The Loop, Not a Pipeline

chapters.title: Where the work moved
chapters.purpose: Return to the opening provocation and relocate human creativity rather than defend it.
chapters.thesis: Cheap production does not diminish human creativity; it moves it from making the first artifact to deciding what is worth making at all.
